Hi, thanks for visiting.

Fan of The Wheel Of Time series for many years - longer than I realised! I also love to organise things. These two facts alone are probably what keeps me here!

Aside from the above, my interests tend to lie in the direction of fashion (hence my chosen name) and music. Oh, and shoes. Can't have enough shoes ;)
